description: Site 9001's report of the routine visit of 10 Jun 2013 (V-9001-R2) was indexed with the next visit's date, 5 Aug 2013, and filed 12 Aug 2013. The 5 Aug visit has its own report too, so two reports carry that date and none carries 10 Jun.
ideal: The 10 Jun visit shows no report: the index gives nothing else to tie D-1-MV2 to it. One finding for V-9001-R2; the 5 Aug visit is covered.
